## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `28c2be6ac7968ca70f04b7d7f0c9209b83a1f893`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #33063 (body, triage 6847247633, claim 6884734169, os-dev-report 6885304558; no ruling, no earlier record), PR #33496 body and its 18-file list, net diff `origin/main...28c2be6a` (merge-base `34c05229`, 18 files, +444/−0), and the head's check-runs. Declaration face: no published schema and no governed path in the tree; the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line alone owes this review.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: the login page's post-login effect now acts on `?error=` for a signed-in arrival — RIGHT.** Before, `callbackError` was read only by the signed-out form; a signed-in person got the spinner and `window.location.assign(withConsoleBase(redirect or '/'))` with the code dropped (the card's step 4). Now `holdLinkRefusalForLanding(callbackError?.code)` sits after the OAuth-provider and mobile hand-off exits (which leave the console and must not carry it) and before the organization and landing exits (which all land in the console, `/organizations` included). The accept set is exactly the keys of `SIGNED_IN_LINK_REFUSALS` = {`email_does_not_match`}; every other code, including markup, is not kept (`isSignedInLinkRefusal` uses `hasOwnProperty`, so `__proto__`/`constructor` are refused too). `callbackError` is a `useMemo(..., [])`, so adding it to the dependency list adds no re-runs, and the hold is idempotent on the re-runs the other deps already cause.
- **Accept-set: the landing reads the slot back through the same map — RIGHT.** `LinkRefusalNotice` removes the value on read (shown once), re-checks it with `isSignedInLinkRefusal`, and renders only the locale sentence via `signedInLinkRefusalMessage`; a slot value with no sentence is dropped and never shown (pinned by `LoginPage.linkRefusal-33063` case 3). Nothing from the URL reaches the DOM (pinned by the `%3Cimg...` CONTROL in `App.linkRefusalLanding-33063`). Storage failures are caught on both ends and degrade to today's behaviour.
- **Signed-out accept set unchanged — RIGHT.** `ssoCallbackRefusalMessage` and the sign-in map are untouched; the #32992 sentence for `access_denied` is pinned unchanged and `LoginPage.access-denied-32992.test.tsx` is untouched.
- **Public surface, `@object-ui/i18n`: one key, `auth.login.errors.linkEmailMismatch`, in all eleven packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; `git grep -c` = 1 each at the head; the tree has exactly these eleven) — RIGHT, a widening.** The exported `en` pack and `TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`) gain one member; nothing renamed or removed. House precedent (console CHANGELOG, e.g. `console.studio.accessRequired`, `oauth.consent.scope.*`) files exactly this as `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- **Public surface, `@object-ui/console`: none at the package boundary — RIGHT.** The package `exports` is only `.` → `./plugin.js` (files: `dist`, `plugin.*`, `README.md`), so the new `src/` exports (`LinkRefusalNotice`, `holdLinkRefusalForLanding`, `LINK_REFUSAL_STORAGE_KEY`, `isSignedInLinkRefusal`, `signedInLinkRefusalMessage`) are not importable surface. What ships is SPA behaviour: a persistent `sonner` error toast (`id: 'link-refusal'`, `duration: Infinity`, close button) on the landing page, and a tab-scoped `sessionStorage` key `objectstack.console.linkRefusal`, internal to the SPA.
- **Server / spec / metadata: no change — RIGHT.** No `packages/` file outside `ui/` in the diff; the refusal (better-auth `email_does_not_match`, no account row) and plugin-auth's `onAPIError.errorURL: this.getConsolePageUrl('/login')` are as the PR states. `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct: nothing a metadata author writes changes.
- **The card's expectation is met.** The card asks that B "sees why the link was refused (e.g. on the Linked accounts page or a toast)": the toast on the landing page is one of the two named shapes, and the claim's file surface named it. The two-leg App test (real `LoginPage`, then real `App` reopened at the URL handed to `location.assign`, only `sessionStorage` surviving) is the right shape for a full-page-load hand-off; red-first on main's `LoginPage`/`App` (2 failed) and the ablation of the one map entry (2 failed, restored blob == HEAD) both bite the two positive cases.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/33063-link-refusal-email-mismatch-notice.md`: `'@object-ui/console': patch`, `'@object-ui/i18n': patch`. Both packages are released (not private, version 18.4.0) and both are moved by the diff, so a changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` would be wrong — it is absent. **Matches.**
- Level: AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3 — `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`; a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. Nothing removed or renamed, so no BREAKING banner, no migration and no ADR-0087 marker is owed. **`patch` is right for both.**
- `Clause-②:` — PR body `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, changeset `Clause-②: yes (widening) — ... gain one key ...; no key is renamed or removed.`, claim `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: all three agree and the diff bears it out (one additive i18n key; additive console behaviour). `Metadata-protocol: none` in all three. **Right.**
- Gate verdicts on the head (60 check-runs at read time): **0 failure.** success (14): Check Changeset (first run), PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, Auto Label, filter, Build UI Deps, Plan Test UI shards, Live E2E UI, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates. skipped (17, path-filtered or opt-in): Build Core, Plan Test Core shards, Test Core shard matrix, Dogfood Regression Gate shard matrix, Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, Build Docs, UI Published Artifacts, Queue verdict, Borrowed queue verdict, Schedule gate, 18.x upgrade harness x2, Packed-tarball smoke x2, plus the label-triggered re-run's Auto Label and Check PR Size. **PENDING (29, in_progress):** Test UI (1/16 … 16/16), Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Check Changeset (label-triggered re-run). This PASS is on the contract; it does not stand in for any pending gate — the merge gate is those runs going green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: `[]` — nothing to answer.
- `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (class a): better-auth 1.7.12 `linkOAuthAccount` also refuses a signed-in link with `account_already_linked_to_different_user` and `unable_to_link_account`, redirected to the same Console error URL; a signed-in person meeting either still lands with no word. **ESCALATED to the seat:** same defect family as #33063, outside this card's one code; file it as its own card (one `SIGNED_IN_LINK_REFUSALS` entry plus one key in eleven locales each, per the PR's own acceptance note). Not a blocker here: the card names only `email_does_not_match`, and this PR leaves the other two exactly as on `main`.
- `security_findings`: none — concur; only a map-checked code is stored, and only a locale sentence is rendered.
- Deviation, "no labels sent with pr_create": answered — the order named none; `skip-changeset` is correctly absent because the diff publishes. The PR now carries `needs:contract-review` (this review) and auto labels.
- Deviation, harness branch `claude/project-thread-l37saf` instead of a `claude/issue-NNNN-slug` branch: answered — it is the branch the claim comment records (`Branch: claude/project-thread-l37saf`), so the implementation identity matches the claim.
- Deviation, second commit (`28c2be6a`, test isolation: toasts dismissed between cases, slot read by key): answered — test-only, no product change; the head reviewed includes it.
- PR is `draft: true`: flagged for the seat — it must leave draft before it can queue.
- Nit (no effect on correctness or the contract): a person who arrives SIGNED OUT at `/login?error=email_does_not_match` and then signs in with the password form on that same page still has the code in the URL when the post-login effect runs, so the landing will say "The account was not linked…". The sentence is true (that link was refused), so it is not wrong, only unpinned; the signed-out CONTROL pins only the state before sign-in.
- Nit: the changeset's Clause-② line could name, as house precedent does, that the exported `en` pack and `TranslationKeys` gain the member.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-l37saf`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对

Verdict: **ACCEPT** · head `28c2be6a` · 2026-11-14T22:57Z

1. **Shape.** Draft → `main`, `Fixes #33063`. 18 files, +444/−0:
   - `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/` (`LoginPage.tsx`, `ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`, a new rendered test)
   - the new `components/LinkRefusalNotice.tsx`, mounted in `App.tsx` after the console's toaster, with a new App-level test
   - one key, `auth.login.errors.linkEmailMismatch`, in all eleven `@object-ui/i18n` packs
   - one root changeset (`@object-ui/console` + `@object-ui/i18n` patch)

   All of it is on the claimed surface (6884734169).
2. **Premise.** Measured by the dev: `LoginPage` reads `callbackError` only in its signed-out form. A signed-in person who comes back with `?error=email_does_not_match` gets the spinner and the post-login `window.location.assign`, and the code is dropped.
   - **The fix:** just before the exits that land in the console, the login page keeps a known link-refusal code in a tab-scoped `sessionStorage` slot. The hand-off exits that leave the console come first and carry nothing. On the landing page, `LinkRefusalNotice` takes the code out once, checks it against the same map again, and shows one persistent, translated error toast.
   - Only codes in `SIGNED_IN_LINK_REFUSALS` (today `email_does_not_match`) travel. The check uses `hasOwnProperty`, nothing from the URL reaches the DOM, and a storage failure falls back to today's behaviour.
   - The signed-out map and #32992's `access_denied` sentence are untouched.
   - **Pins:** through the real App twice, red-first on `main`, plus a mapping ablation; CONTROLs for no `error`, an unknown or markup code, and the signed-out `access_denied` path.
3. **Contract record.** PASS 6885355346 on this head: one additive i18n key, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch` right. No exported surface of `@object-ui/console`'s package boundary changes.
4. **Gates on head `28c2be6a`.**
   - All 66 check runs are `success` or `skipped`, including Test UI shards + aggregate, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset and PR-body guards.
   - The dev's local `--ran` is 38/38.
5. **Nit (no change asked).** A signed-out person who signs in with the password form on `/login?error=email_does_not_match` will also see the link toast after signing in. The sentence is still true; no test covers that path.
6. **K.** 13 first-parent commits since base `34c05229` < 15, so no base sync.
7. **Out of scope.** The sibling codes `account_already_linked_to_different_user` and `unable_to_link_account` still land with no word. Carded as #33498 (p3, serial after this PR, same files).
8. **Authority.** Landing under the maintainer's standing authorisation 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z).
